purpose: Re-audit the forty-seven terminal three-session mechanisms without reading a new candidate value and select one cross-stock liquidity-participation mechanism that is not a rescue or transformation of a terminal factor.

overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_participation_entropy_24: Measures the concentration of one stock's own normalized continuous-session amount profile. The selected candidate instead measures alignment with a leave-one-out market profile; two stocks with equal entropy can have different market-profile synchronization.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_profile_serial_persisten: Measures adjacent-position dependence within one stock-day. The selected candidate compares the whole aligned profile with other stocks and can change while the stock's own serial persistence is fixed.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m: Measures the time location of one stock's own amount. The selected candidate depends on the shape of the leave-one-out market profile, not only the stock's amount-weighted average position.
overlap_reaudit.late_amount_share_30m: Measures a fixed late-session subtotal of one stock. The selected candidate uses all 240 aligned continuous positions and a cross-stock benchmark.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p: Measures within-stock synchronous coupling between amount and absolute price movement. The selected candidate reads no price and compares normalized amount profiles across stocks.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_lead_return_correlation_: Measures within-stock lagged amount-return dependence. The selected candidate reads no return and has no lead-lag transform.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_up_move_amount_share_238m: Allocates amount by the sign of one stock's price move. The selected candidate is direction-blind and reads no price.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_opening_auction_amount_share_24: Measures only the separately reported 09:30 amount share. The selected candidate explicitly excludes 09:30 and measures continuous-session cross-stock profile alignment.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_market_idiosyncratic_share_238m: Measures cross-stock synchronization of aligned minute returns. The selected candidate uses normalized amount participation only; a change in prices with every amount fixed changes the terminal return factor but not this candidate.
overlap_reaudit.all_other_price_path_factors: Realized volatility, semivariance, recovery, close location, sign runs, volatility resolution, diffusive ratio, variance entropy, skewness, VWAP pressure, price-update share, late return and late VWAP all require price behavior that this candidate never reads.
overlap_reaudit.daily_fundamental_event_or_regime_factor: Those mechanisms use daily, point-in-time fundamental, event, or shared regime states. This candidate is a stock-specific cross-sectional comparison of already purchased minute amount profiles.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: market_amount_profile_idiosyncratic_share
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: This is the inverse/residualized direction of the selected synchronization mechanism and is not a separately testable candidate.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: negative_or_absolute_synchronization
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Direction and transformation shopping are prohibited.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: auction_inclusive_profile
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: This would partially recycle the terminal opening-auction mechanism and expose the known special-row semantics.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: volume_or_trade_count_substitution
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.formula: Normalize volume or an unavailable trade-count field
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: The observable is frozen to CNY amount and no substitution is allowed.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: alternative_similarity_or_regression
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.formula: Cosine similarity, rank correlation, beta, R-squared, robust regression, distance, lagged correlation, or dynamic time warping
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: These are transformations of the same frozen profile-alignment mechanism.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: alternative_peer_benchmark
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.formula: Index, industry, board, exchange, size, selected-peer, median, trimmed, weighted, or non-leave-one-out market profile
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Peer selection and weighting would add post-result degrees of freedom.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: window_threshold_subset_or_filter_variants
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.formula: Morning, afternoon, late, high-amount, event, board, year, liquidity, volatility, or other subsets
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Rewindowing, thresholding, filtering, and subset rescue are prohibited.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
selected_candidate.own_profile: For stock i and aligned position t, p_i,t=amount_i,t/sum_t(amount_i,t) over the exact 240-position continuous-session grid.
selected_candidate.peer_pool: Every other source stock-day on the same trade date with a valid nonnegative 240-position amount profile.
selected_candidate.leave_one_out_market_profile: At every aligned position, subtract p_i,t from the same-date cross-sectional profile sum and one from the valid-profile count, then divide by the remaining count.
selected_candidate.formula: PearsonCorr(p_i, mean(p_j for valid j != i)) with an intercept across the 240 aligned positions
selected_candidate.hypothesis: A high value means the stock's intraday liquidity participation follows broad-market liquidity waves rather than isolated bursts, indicating more orderly and broadly sponsored trading that may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: The factor is not computable from a single stock-day. Holding the stock's own normalized amount profile fixed while changing other stocks' profiles can change its value. It reads no price, return, 09:30 amount, volume, fundamental, event, industry, capitalization, or forward-return field.

decision: Proceed only to a separately hash-bound no-return preregistration. Do not compute a candidate value until that second artifact is frozen.
